The accessible primary source independently supplies min cardinality six. No finite experiment is extrapolated to infinite graph orders.

value.rationale: At adjacent graph orders eight and nine, the known optimal [1,2]-domination budget stays six, but the complete optimizer concept family collapses 248 to nine and both static and adaptive dimensions collapse sharply. The nine-element family admits a conceptual three-by-three periodic description, in contrast with 32 maximum shattered supports in two dihedral orbits and nonpure facets at order eight. The precise comparison tests whether a known extremal cardinality measures optimizer diversity; it does not and gives a mathematically natural period-six boundary case.
